أنتفخ (form VIII)
# أَنْتَفِخُ (ʔantafiḵu) /ʔan.ta.fi.xu/: first-person singular non-past active indicative of اِنْتَفَخَ (intafaḵa)
# أَنْتَفِخَ (ʔantafiḵa) /ʔan.ta.fi.xa/: first-person singular non-past active subjunctive of اِنْتَفَخَ (intafaḵa)
# أَنْتَفِخْ (ʔantafiḵ) /ʔan.ta.fix/: first-person singular non-past active jussive of اِنْتَفَخَ (intafaḵa)
kaikki_vikisozluk.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
